notes: Worked Example: Density Calculation with Significant Figures
Mass of an object is measured to be 4.237 kg (four significant figures) and its volume is measured to be 2.51 m³ (three significant figures), then its density is given by
Here 1.6880 kg m⁻³ has five significant figures but according to rule it should be expressed to only three significant figures i.e. 1.69 kg m⁻³.
One must remember that in general, the final result should not have more significant figures than the original data from which it was obtained.

Area of an object is measured to be (2.51 m³) as five significant figures but the least precise measurement must also be expressed to the 0.1 decimal place so our final result should be expressed to the 0.1 decimal place, giving us 106.3 kg.
But the least precise measurement is 103.9. This measurement is expressed to the 0.1 decimal place. Thus, the answer is rounded to the tenths place, giving us 106.319 kg = 106.3 kg.

Example 5: How many years older will you be 1.00 billion seconds from now? (Assume a 365-day year.)
$$1 \times 10^9 \text{s} \times \frac{1\text{ h}}{3600\text{ s}} \times \frac{1 \text{ day}}{24 \text{ h}} \times \frac{1 \text{ y}}{365 \text{ day}} = 31.75 \text{ years}$$

Example 7: Find the value of 10 joule on a system which has 10 g, 100 s and 30 cm as the fundamental units.
Joule is the S.I. unit of energy and dimensional formula of energy is [ML²T⁻²].
Here a=1, b=2, c=-2. S.I. unit: N₁ = 10, M₁ = 1 kg, L₁ = 1 m, T₁ = 1 s. New units: N₂ = ?, M₂ = 100 gm, L₂ = 30 cm, T₂ = 30 s
$$N_2 = 10 \times \left[\frac{1\text{ kg}}{100\text{ gm}}\right] \times \left[\frac{1\text{ m}}{30\text{ cm}}\right]^2 \times \left[\frac{1\text{ s}}{30\text{ s}}\right]^{-2}$$
Putting these values in above equation, we get N₂ = 9 × 10⁶ new units.
Example 8: The edge of a cube is measured to be 7.203 m. What is the total surface area and the volume of the cube, to the appropriate number of significant figures?
Answer: Given, edge of the cube (l) = 7.203 m — four significant figures.
Total surface area of a cube: A = 6l²
Since 7.203 has four significant figures, both results are rounded to four significant figures: total surface area = 311.3 m² and volume = 373.7 m³.
